verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an MCP registry, hosted service and CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any opt-out setting or environment variable for the Smithery CLI or services. The credential-storage and token-scoping items are adjacent security controls, not telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
